question: Which scope fields must a single-kb chat response echo?
mock_answer: A single-kb response must echo requested_scope_type, requested_kb_ids, effective_scope_type, effective_kb_ids, is_default_deny_applied, and isolation_level.

source_nodes.title: scope-contract.md
source_nodes.text: Chat responses must echo requested_scope_type, requested_kb_ids, effective_scope_type, effective_kb_ids, is_default_deny_applied, and isolation_level.

question: Which fields are required so the frontend can preview evidence?
mock_answer: Evidence items need title, source, excerpt, doc_id, and preview_locator so the frontend can render evidence preview and source location.

source_nodes.title: evidence-preview.md
source_nodes.text: EvidenceItem should include title, source, excerpt, doc_id, and preview_locator so the frontend can build a minimal evidence preview.

question: What should the P0 ingestion and QA baseline stabilize first?
mock_answer: The P0 baseline should stabilize Markdown import, indexing, single-kb QA, and evidence preview first; PDF and image OCR must expose dependency readiness clearly.

source_nodes.title: ingestion-readiness.md
source_nodes.text: P0 should stabilize Markdown import, indexing, single-kb QA, and evidence preview before expanding PDF and image OCR evaluation.

question: How should the assistant respond when the current KB has no confirmable evidence?
mock_answer: When the current KB has no confirmable evidence, the assistant should say that no confirmable information is available and must not fabricate an answer.

source_nodes.title: refusal-guideline.md
source_nodes.text: If the current knowledge base has no confirmable evidence, the answer should explicitly say so and must not fabricate.

question: How should folders relate to a knowledge base?
mock_answer: Folders are organizational objects inside one knowledge base; they help import tree display and browsing, but they do not create a separate authorization boundary.
must_not_contain: each folder is its own KB

source_nodes.title: folder-boundary.md
source_nodes.text: Folders are organizational objects inside one knowledge base and do not create a separate authorization boundary.

question: Which metrics should the QA baseline report track?
mock_answer: The QA baseline report should track scope pass rate, keypoint coverage, evidence hit rate, preview resolvability rate, source count match rate, and forbidden-term clean rate.
must_not_contain: pass or fail alone is enough

source_nodes.title: suite-metrics-gate.md
